alcohol.answer: Royal Air Maroc says alcohol of up to 70° is authorised subject to strict volume limits per container and per passenger, but the page gives no figures. In the cabin, liquids and creams must be in containers of 100 ml or less inside a transparent 20 cm by 20 cm bag.

sections.h: 🥃 What Royal Air Maroc says about alcohol
sections.p: From the "Baggage restrictions" block of the Royal Air Maroc Special baggage page, read on 22 November 2026.

head: Question
Royal Air Maroc rule
rows: Strict, per container and per passenger; no numbers on the page
Containers of 100 ml or less in a transparent bag of 20 cm by 20 cm
Yes, in one line of the restrictions block

list: Not on the page: the litre limits, and whether a bottle goes in the cabin or the hold. Ask Royal Air Maroc before you fly with a bottle.

faq: Can I take alcohol on Royal Air Maroc?
Yes up to 70° within strict per-container and per-passenger limits that the page does not spell out.
What size bag do liquids go in on Royal Air Maroc?
A transparent plastic bag of 20 cm by 20 cm, with containers of 100 ml or less.
